history_summary.value: The Serama was developed in Kelantan, Malaysia, in the early 1970s from a mix of small local and Japanese-type bantams, and was named after a figure from traditional shadow puppet theatre. It is bred mainly as a show bird, prized in Malaysia for its tiny size and confident, upright carriage.
